text: Safilo Group S.p.A. is listed on the Milan stock exchange; Multibrands Italy B.V., a subsidiary of HAL Holding N.V., is its reference shareholder, with 49.8% of the share capital.
short: Safilo is listed in Milan; HAL Holding's Multibrands Italy holds 49.8%.

source.name: Safilo Group: Shareholding
source.quote: Multibrands Italy B.V.'s stake in the share capital of Safilo increased to 49.8%
